description: This file defines a simple caching service using SharedPreferences in Dart. It provides methods to store, retrieve, and manage cached JSON data with timestamp validation, as well as handling string lists.

classes.name: CacheEntry
classes.description: A data class representing a cached JSON string along with the timestamp when it was saved.

classes.name: SimpleCache
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to cache JSON data and string lists using SharedPreferences, with support for TTL-based expiry.

methods.name: putJson
methods.description: Stores a JSON object as a string in cache under a specific key, with the current timestamp.

methods.name: getJsonIfFresh
methods.description: Retrieves a cached JSON entry if it exists and is still fresh according to the provided TTL.

methods.name: getJsonEvenIfStale
methods.description: Retrieves a cached JSON entry regardless of its age, if it exists.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries associated with a specific key.

methods.name: setStringList
methods.description: Stores a list of strings in cache under a specific key.

methods.name: getStringList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of strings from cache; returns an empty list if none exists.
